description: The Arizona Police Association (APA), one of Arizona's leading law enforcement organizations, has endorsed Senator Wendy Rogers for re-election in Legislative District 7. The endorsement reflects Rogers' long-standing support for Arizona's law enforcement officers, first responders, and public safety professionals throughout her service in the Arizona Legislature. The Arizona Police Association represents thousands of police
